title: Veristack Self-Verification Core Security & Monotonicity Laws

laws.invariant: Strict receipt validation accepts only HMAC-authenticated, treeHash-matching, exit-0 receipts whose test counts are positive and whose planted-fault canary meets >= 75% kill rate with 0 invalid kills (modeled in .verification/formal/veristack_gates.qnt).
Ratchet evaluation rejects any rung grade downgrade, CI execution drop, archetype excuse to not-applicable, or missing rung snapshot.
Agent pre-edit and stop hooks fail closed on empty/malformed payloads, protected control-plane writes, shell tampering, and tampered hooks.json.
Canary mutant classification, AST operators, two-sided oracle checks, report parsers, and workflow-audit multi-hop reusable expansion are pinned against regressions.
